metadata.scope: Crosswalk review between the 43 new NP-NCD source manifestations and the 1,046 HMIS knowledge objects in the current registry.
metadata.policy: A thematic match is not treated as a computable crosswalk. Exact linkage requires compatible construct, numerator, denominator, period, population and reporting level.

relatedHmisObjects.name: Number of beneficiaries who are registered at the NCD clinic
relatedHmisObjects.relationship: Related to NCD registration, but not sufficient to compute population enrolment, screening, diagnosis, treatment or control coverage.

relatedHmisObjects.name: Number of deaths due to Cancer
relatedHmisObjects.relationship: Disease-specific mortality count outside the cited NP-NCD monitoring manifestations.
relatedHmisObjects.decision: Retain as a distinct related outcome object

relatedHmisObjects.name: Number of deaths due to Heart disease/Hypertension related
relatedHmisObjects.relationship: Mortality count is not equivalent to hypertension incidence or clinical control.
relatedHmisObjects.decision: Retain as a distinct related outcome object

relatedHmisObjects.name: Number of deaths due to Neurological disease including strokes
relatedHmisObjects.relationship: Mortality count is not equivalent to stroke-service readiness, diagnosis or treatment initiation.
relatedHmisObjects.decision: Retain as a distinct related outcome object

excludedFromCrosswalk: Pregnancy-specific hypertension and gestational-diabetes elements because their population and clinical pathway are RMNCH+A-specific.
Childhood-asthma and mixed inpatient respiratory elements because their age group, construct and condition set differ from the NP-NCD manifestations.
Raw mortality counts because none supplies the denominators or cohorts required by the NP-NCD coverage and control measures.

nextEvidenceRequired: Current custodian-approved National NCD Portal field and indicator dictionary, including field codes, numerator/denominator specifications, validation rules and reporting hierarchy.
